verdict.rationale: SAM.gov publishes a broad set of read APIs covering most UI search domains: Entity Management with rich filtering and tiered data access, Opportunities, Exclusions, Contracts, Federal Hierarchy and Assistance Listings. All documented calls are GET retrievals, though, and core UI actions such as registering an entity or getting a Unique Entity ID have no documented API equivalent. Wage Determinations lookup also appears only in the UI. Missing for 10: API equivalents for UI write workflows (entity registration/UEI request), a Wage Determinations API, and independent confirmation of UI-to-API parity.
